after.source: GL_META of remote software-WebGL2 captures (SwiftShader, 1280x720, settle-60s shot): before = g17p5-r1b (4.7.3 build 4d9f3d7f4), after = g17p6-r1 (4dd97eb04). Per-draw breakdown of the before build: p6-d1/drawlist-4.7.3.json (g17p6-d1).
after.fix: Meshy lanterns (10), islands (6) and the blob decal no longer cast the sun shadow under the colour script (castShadow false): each was one depth draw per sun cascade (2 cascades at the capture tier), -34 draws and about -497k triangles. They still write the contact-shadow depth and still receive. The sky dome stays a caster: it sets the legacy cascade fit, and dropping it would change the panel-won look.
after.phase3PlusNine: Phase 3 (3b22bb312) added the prayer-flag posts and cords as extra instances of the verge-flags draw: 152 -> 342 instances (372 since the phase-4 gates). In the main pass that is still 1 draw, but the shadow-depth shader instances through a 64-entry uniform array (PRD02_DEPTH_MAX_INSTANCES), so the node went from 3 to 6 depth draws in each of the 3 depth passes (2 sun cascades + the contact-shadow depth): +9 draws, and +9,120 triangles (190 boxes x 12 x 4 draws including the main pass). Not changed in this phase: splitting it further would cost the gate and post shadows.
after.notLaneScope: The 4 lens-flare sprites (High, stages 1, 2, 3, 8) are also drawn into both cascades (8 draws) by the engine's flare items; that is an engine fix (castShadow false on the flare render items), not made in a game lane.
